answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the fable accrues. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the marble of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the sonnet expensive rather than free. Seal 122lo.
